Hockrow Agency
Case File #BR56263
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Summary:
Need an operative to extract the blackbox from a destroyed ship. The ship’s owner claims that it was genuinely lost in an outlaw attack, but the insurance company has doubts. We’ve been hired to find out which is true.
I suspect that the perpetrators are long gone by now, so you shouldn't run into any resistance.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Proceed to [LOCATION], secure the black box in the derelict spaceship there and return it to [DESTINATION].
Additional Notes:
You will need to EVA for this one so make sure you got a suit.

霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #BR56263
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

需要一名特工从一艘被摧毁的飞船中提取黑匣子。飞船的所有者声称黑匣子确实是在一次非法分子的袭击中丢失的，但保险公司对此表示怀疑。我们受雇来查明真相。

我怀疑作案者早就逃走了，所以你应该不会遇到任何抵抗。

合约调查员的行动：
前往 [LOCATION]，在废弃的飞船中找到黑匣子，并将其带回 [DESTINATION]。

补充说明：
这次任务你需要进行舱外活动，所以一定要穿上宇航服。

1g9jltb.description_en:
Congrats on completing part four of this eight-part course.
The fifth scenario focuses on defensive tactics. Knowing when to take evasive measures and deploy either decoys or noise countermeasures is essential to your survival. That’s why the aggressors in this exercise will be armed with missiles.
Ensure your countermeasures are fully stocked and then go to [LOCATION] to start.
As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of 12 MG Scrip.
TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Ready to Launch - Easy access to your decoys and countermeasures can be critical in your success in dealing with incoming missile fire.
- Stand and Fight - Resist the temptation to hit the afterburner to escape as you’ll increase your signature and make it easier for the missile to hit you. They’re almost certainly much faster than you anyway.
- Close the Gap – While it may seem counterintuitive, getting closer to an enemy ship can be an advantage. Missiles have a minimum range and if you’re inside of it they won’t be able to get a lock on you.
Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly
ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
1g9jltb.description_zh:
恭喜完成八节课程的第四部分。

场景 5 重点训练防御战术。学会在何时采取规避动作、释放诱饵弹或干扰弹是生存的关键。本次训练的敌舰将配备导弹武器。

请确保携带足量反导装备，随后前往 [LOCATION] 开始训练。

作为奖励，成功完成该场景后，原始合约持有人将获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证。

实战技巧：
- 快速反应 - 将诱饵弹和干扰弹设置为快捷键，这对应对导弹袭击至关重要
- 稳住阵脚 - 不要试图用加力燃烧逃跑，这反而会增大信号特征让导弹更容易锁定你（反正导弹肯定比你快）。
- 近身战术 - 看似违反直觉，但贴近敌舰反而有利。导弹有最小射程限制，贴身时无法锁定你。


祝你好运，
教练吉利

1g9jltd.description_en:
Congrats on completing part six of this eight-part course.
You’ve gained a lot of experience across the past six scenarios, and now it’s time to put it all to practice. Scenario seven puts you up against a corvette-class ship and its escorts. This extended encounter will push you to the limit and test everything you got.
The only thing left is to understand the limit of your skillset. To put it simply, you can’t do everything yourself. Developing and maintaining relationships with fellow pilots that you can call upon for support is really the last piece of the puzzle. Not saying you can't overcome encounters like this by yourself, but even the Navy doesn’t send their ace pilots on a patrol alone.
Once you decided whether to do this alone or call in some support, head over to [LOCATION] to kick off the encounter.
As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of 16 MG Scrip.
TRICKS OF THE TRADE
- Strength in Diversity – Think about the roles your allies will be filling and choose who to bring carefully to help balance strengths and weaknesses. You’ll want ships capable of taking on the Corvette while others deal with the escort.
Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly
ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
1g9jltd.description_zh:

现在只剩最后一项要领悟：个人能力的极限。说白了，单打独斗总有尽头。发展和维护与其他飞行员的关系，能在关键时刻呼叫支援，才是终极解决方案。当然独狼也能完成任务——但就连海军也从不让王牌飞行员单独出勤。

决定好单干还是呼叫支援后，请前往 [LOCATION] 开始战斗。

- 优势互补 - 慎重选择援军阵容，确保有人牵制护卫舰时，其他人能解决护航舰队。合理搭配各舰职能才能扬长避短。

After a contractor successfully recovered data stolen from one of our clients, a security analyst verified that it was captured by unauthorized surveillance monitors illegally installed around [LOCATION]. We’re looking for someone to follow up and take out those monitors.

Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement

1wg0aum.description_en:
Hi,
Got a relatively straightforward one for you if you're interested.
One of our pilot ignored a maintenance warning and sure enough, a couple of hours later their ship broke down over at [LOCATION]. They're on their way back to the office now but we could do with a reliable hauler whose got a ship big enough to transport [MAX_SCU] cargo containers to complete the haul for us.
Think you could help us out? You just need to pick up the stranded shipment and deliver it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. And I probably don't have to say this, but a heavy-duty tractor beam would probably be handy to have along.
Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling
Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
1wg0aum.description_zh:
嗨，

有个挺简单的活儿，你要是有兴趣的话。

我们一个飞行员没当回事，直接无视了维护警报，结果几小时后，飞船真在 [LOCATION] 那儿抛锚了。人现在正回办公室路上，但我们需要个靠谱的运输员，开艘能装下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱 的大船，帮我们把这趟货拉完。

你觉得能搭把手不？先去把滞留的货取走，再送到 [DESTINATION] 那儿的货运电梯就行。我猜不用多说你也知道，带个重型牵引光束肯定更方便。

谢谢，
雷耶斯·玲
货运物流协调员
玲家快递


玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

Looking for someone who can not only dogfight but recruit others to the Headhunters cause. Our operations center at [LOCATION], along with any ships going to and from it, are being targeted by hostile forces. We need support there pronto.
Not gonna lie, but there’s lots of heat around there. That’s why you’ll need to be fully supplied and find some trustworthy friends to fly at your wing. When you get your crew together, head out there and I’ll update you if there’s any flare ups in the area that need your attention.

这次行动必须万无一失，所以我打算给完成任务的主要承包人额外奖励 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

18xtolx.description_en:
An executive client just informed us that their 890 Jump had been intercepted at [LOCATION] and boarded by outlaws. They would prefer to have this handled privately owing to the sensitive nature of proprietary data that's being stored aboard.
Your first priority will be to clear all outlaws as quickly as possible so that a recovery team can be dispatched to return the ship to the owner. The longer the outlaws have control of the vessel, the higher the chance it will be lost. I recommend you acquire a team for this outing to expedite matters.
Note that thanks to a small contingent of Security Personnel who stayed aboard, all surviving members of the crew were able to flee in an escape craft. The current status of the remaining security is unknown, but just in case, keep an eye out for friendlies when you engage the hostiles.
Secondly, if at all possible, the client is *very* interested in preventing the theft of the aforementioned data. If you are able to stop the theft of their confidential data stores before they are transmitted, a generous bonus will be issued.
Needless to say, this is a client I would very much like to keep happy.
Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group
18xtolx.description_zh:
一位行政客户刚刚向我们发出求救信号，他们的 890 跃动在 [LOCATION] 被拦截并被不法分子登上了船。因为船上存了一些比较敏感的私人数据，所以他们更希望能私下处理这个问题。

你的首要任务是把不法分子以最快的速度清理掉，这样一支救援小组就能派遣过去把船返还给船主。让这些非法之徒控制这艘船的时间越长，它被抢走的可能性就越大。为了能更快速的解决问题，我建议你组织一个特勤小组来执行此任务。

需要注意的一点是，船上所有幸存的船员都在船上的私人安全部队的保护下坐救生艇安全逃离了。不过，现在船上的状况仍然无法确定，为了以防万一，执行任务的时候请务必留意是否还有友军，以免误伤。

还有，如果可能的话，我们的客户会“非常乐意”看到你能把飞船内的数据保护下来不被盗走。如果你能成功阻止这些机密数据以远程传输的方式被盗走，会有一笔非常丰厚的额外奖金等着你。

如果换作是我的话，我会尽全力完成这位客户的要求让他满意。

布雷登·科查多
后勤官员 - 斯坦顿分部
北境之岩服务团队
